name: Chicken Congee
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical congee recipes using 1/2 cup rice and 8 oz chicken (4 modest adult servings).
Total time summed from explicit instruction intervals (20-25 min simmer + 10 min chicken + negligible prep/stir times) plus ~10 min estimated for marinating/rinsing/setup; rounded to nearest 5 min.
Ginger cordial treated as ginger juice (no allergens added).
Spring onions, coriander, and ginger are fresh produce (no allergens).
No wheat, barley, rye, oats, or gluten-containing sauces listed; rice is plain white rice.
No dairy, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, or soy listed.
Sesame left null (possible in some Chinese kitchens but not listed here).
All classifications based strictly on listed ingredients with no substitutions.
instructions:
STEP 1 - MARINATING THE CHICKEN
In a bowl, add chicken, salt, white pepper, ginger juice and then mix it together well.
Set the chicken aside.
STEP 2 - RINSE THE WHITE RICE
Rinse the rice in a metal bowl or pot a couple times and then drain the water.
STEP 2 - BOILING THE WHITE RICE
Next add 8 cups of water and then set the stove on high heat until it is boiling. Once rice porridge starts to boil, set the stove on low heat and then stir it once every 8-10 minutes for around 20-25 minutes.
After 25 minutes, this is optional but you can add a little bit more water to make rice porridge to make it less thick or to your preference.
Next add the marinated chicken to the rice porridge and leave the stove on low heat for another 10 minutes.
After an additional 10 minutes add the green onions, sliced ginger, 1 pinch of salt, 1 pinch of white pepper and stir for 10 seconds.
Serve the rice porridge in a bowl
Optional: add Coriander on top of the rice porridge.

ingredients.name: Chicken
ingredients.assumptions: 8 oz raw boneless skinless chicken breast, typical for congee; values for raw poultry meat.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.assumptions: Pinch of table salt used in marinade; negligible mass but included as 1 g for position completeness.

ingredients.name: Pepper
ingredients.assumptions: Pinch of white pepper used in marinade; negligible mass but included as 1 g for position completeness.

ingredients.name: Ginger Cordial
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tsp ginger cordial/juice; treated as sweetened ginger extract with modest sugar content.

ingredients.name: Ginger
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tsp grated fresh ginger added during cooking; typical density and nutrient profile for raw ginger root.

ingredients.name: Spring Onions
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tbs chopped spring onions/green onions added at end; typical for garnish in congee.

ingredients.name: Rice
ingredients.assumptions: 1/2 cup uncooked white rice (standard long-grain); ~100 g dry weight before rinsing and boiling.

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.assumptions: 8 cups water used to cook rice into porridge; standard US cup = 237 ml each, total ~1.9 L, treated as pure water with zero macros.

ingredients.name: Coriander
ingredients.assumptions: 2 oz fresh coriander/cilantro as optional topping; typical raw leafy herb values.
